title: Growing Bean

serves.summary: The child stacks cubes beside a bean plant each day, puts each day's height on a cube chart, then finds the tallest day, the day it did not grow, or how many cubes it grew.

request.topic: Measuring a growing plant over several days
request.objective: Measure a growing plant with cubes on several days, record each day's count, and tell which day it was tallest and how it changed.

problems.ask: Measure the bean with cubes on Day 1 and on Day 2, and put each day on the chart.
problems.goal: Day 1 is 2 cubes and Day 2 is 4 cubes, each stack starting on the soil with no gaps, both on the chart.

problems.ask: A rabbit nibbled the bean one night. Measure the bean each day, then put the star on the day it was tallest.
problems.goal: 3, 5 and 4 cubes on the chart; the star on Day 2. The last day is not the tallest because the top was nibbled.

problems.ask: Measure the bean on all four days. On which day did it not grow at all? Put the star there.
problems.goal: 1, 3, 3 and 5 cubes on the chart; the star on Day 3, the day it stayed as tall as Day 2.

problems.ask: Measure the bean on all three days. How many cubes did it grow from Day 1 to Day 3? Mark those cubes on the chart.
problems.goal: 2, 4 and 7 cubes on the chart; 5 cubes marked on Day 3, the part above Day 1's height.
